source: DOF Parking Violations Issued FY2020-FY2027, camera codes excluded. Exact aggregation: every distinct (precinct, county, street, house number) tuple placed once through LION address ranges, park names, and street-within-precinct, weighted by its ticket count. Harvest reconciled row-for-row against the City’s direct counts for all eight fiscal years. Per-layer unplaced remainders are stored by year.
